title: A potent icaritin derivative ameliorates Parkinson's disease via GPER-mediated mitophagy restoration and dopaminergic neuroprotection.
authors: Wang, Xiaowen; Cao, Xizhen; Cai, Meiyun; Zhao, Ruiyue; Zheng, Yangyang; Zhang, Mei; Shao, Changlun; Chen, Wenfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿素衍生物通过GPER介导线粒体自噬恢复治疗帕金森病，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与课题无关。
abstract: Icaritin (ICT), a major prenylated flavone from Epimedium with anti-osteoporosis, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory properties, is limited clinically by poor water solubility and low bioavailability. In this study, ICT derivatives were prepared via multi-step chemical reactions and five ICT derivatives (ICTA, ICTB, ICTC, ICTD and ICTE) were successfully synthesized. Compared with ICT, most derivatives exhibited improved solubility and reduced cytotoxicity. Notably, ICTC showed a significant improvement in aqueous solubility (at least 12-fold higher), favorable lower cytotoxicity (at least 2-fold lower at 20 muM), and prominent neuroprotective effects. Mechanistically, in vitro studies revealed that ICTC targets the G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER) to rescue defective mitophagy by restoring MPP(+)-suppressed expression of mitophagy-related proteins (PINK1, Parkin) and attenuating MPP(+)-induced accumulation of autophagic substrates (LC3-II, P62). In vivo, intraperitoneal injection of ICTC (0.3-3 mg/kg) effectively protected against MPTP-induced damage to dopaminergic neurons and attenuated neuroinflammation. Molecular docking, pharmacological blockade and studies in GPER knockout mouse models of Parkinson's disease (PD) confirmed that the effects of ICTC depend on GPER. Moreover, intravenous injection of ICTC also provided effective dopaminergic neuron protection, addressing the limitations of oral formulation. Overall, ICTC is a promising prodrug with enhanced solubility that exerts anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects in experimental PD by targeting GPER to ameliorate abnormal mitophagy.
abstract_zh: 淫羊藿素（ICT），一种来自淫羊藿的主要异戊烯基黄酮，具有抗骨质疏松、抗癌和抗炎特性，但其临床应用受限于水溶性差和生物利用度低。本研究通过多步化学反应制备了ICT衍生物，并成功合成了五种ICT衍生物（ICTA、ICTB、ICTC、ICTD和ICTE）。与ICT相比，大多数衍生物表现出改善的溶解性和降低的细胞毒性。值得注意的是，ICTC在水溶性方面显著提高（至少高出12倍），具有更低的细胞毒性（在20 μM浓度下至少降低2倍），并展现出显著的神经保护作用。机制上，体外研究表明，ICTC靶向G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER），通过恢复MPP(+)抑制的线粒体自噬相关蛋白（PINK1、Parkin）表达，并减轻MPP(+)诱导的自噬底物（LC3-II、P62）积累，来挽救缺陷的线粒体自噬。在体内，腹腔注射ICTC（0.3-3 mg/kg）有效保护MPTP诱导的多巴胺能神经元损伤，并减轻神经炎症。分子对接、药理学阻断及帕金森病（PD）GPER基因敲除小鼠模型研究证实，ICTC的作用依赖于GPER。此外，静脉注射ICTC也提供了有效的多巴胺能神经元保护，解决了口服制剂的局限性。总体而言，ICTC是一种有前景的前药，具有增强的溶解性，在实验性PD中通过靶向GPER改善异常线粒体自噬，发挥抗炎和神经保护作用。
